kv6.8:1.3: Rūpaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ rūpadhātu nīlaṃ pītakaṃ lohitakaṃ odātaṃ cakkhuviññeyyaṃ cakkhusmiṃ paṭihaññati cakkhussa āpātham āgacchatīti?
kv6.8:2.3: Cakkhuñ ca paṭicca paṭhavīdhātuñ ca uppajjati cakkhuviññāṇan ti?
kv6.8:3.1: Cakkhuñ ca paṭicca paṭhavīdhātuñ ca uppajjati cakkhuviññāṇan ti?
kv6.8:3.3: "Cakkhuñ ca paṭicca paṭhavīdhātuñ ca uppajjati cakkhuviññāṇan ti."
kv6.8:3.6: "Cakkhuñ ca paṭicca rūpe ca uppajjati cakkhuviññāṇan ti."
kv6.8:3.9: Hañci "Cakkhuñ ca paṭicca rūpe ca uppajjati cakkhuviññāṇan ti,"
kv6.8:3.10: atth' eva suttanto, no vata re vattabbe
